content: SPRT for chess engines is standardised on GSPRT with bounds elo0/elo1 and alpha/beta (commonly 0.05). fastchess is the current command-line tournament runner (successor to cutechess-cli) and supports -sprt elo0= elo1= alpha= beta=, time controls, opening books and concurrency. SPRT stops as soon as the log-likelihood ratio crosses a bound, so a regression check can conclude in far fewer than a fixed game count. Confidence MEDIUM: tooling behaviour from docs and community reports, not from reading the source.
